diagnosis.purpose: Codex review 23 item 4: on development data first, whether required symbols are missing from the channels' candidates or merely ranked low. Train and development only; held-out was not opened.
diagnosis.reading: Of 35 requirements, 16 had their symbol returned by no channel within its top 40, so no weight can recover them; 15 were found but fused below 5; 4 were in the fused top 5. Dense alone put 8 in its own top 5, so fusion pushes dense's best results down. On the M1 gold 13 of 22 were found by no channel. Both candidate recall and fusion need work; weights alone cannot reach the floors.
diagnosis.reproduces: Every pooled aggregate equals retrieval.json (tuned, 788190d); the code at this head changed no ranking.
